name: Affiliate Niche Website / SEO Blog

yield.notes: 12+ months to meaningful SEO traffic. Affiliate commissions: 2-20% depending on niche.

flags: Google algorithm updates (HCU, Panda, Penguin) can destroy organic traffic overnight
Amazon Associates commission rates change without notice
AI content detection may penalize thin affiliate content

startup_checklist: Choose niche: specific enough to rank, broad enough to monetize (e.g., 'best hiking gear under $50')
Register domain and set up WordPress or Astro on cheap hosting
Research 50 low-competition keywords using Ahrefs free tools or Ubersuggest
Publish 30 high-quality articles in first 90 days (1,500+ words each)
Apply to Amazon Associates or relevant affiliate programs once 10+ articles live
failure_modes: Google update deindexes or penalizes site
Niche has no buyers — traffic but no clicks
Content quality too low to rank above established sites
kill_criteria: Less than 500 organic visitors/month after 18 months and 50+ articles
sources_note: Earnings ranges from niche site builder community surveys.
